not_found: Paint: Sherwin-Williams, Behr and PPG data sheets not retrieved (Behr 403; SW/PPG URLs 404/not found in sitemaps). Two manufacturers used: Benjamin Moore (TDS PDF) and Valspar (manufacturer product page, not a TDS PDF).
Paint: no data sheet gives a coat count specific to 'changing color' or 'new drywall' other than BM 'On bare substrates, two coats are recommended' and Valspar's drastic-color-change primer advice.
Drywall: USG Gypsum Construction Handbook is a Wiley book, not freely downloadable; screw spacing taken from USG J371 (which follows practice, not quoted from ASTM C840/GA-216 text itself).
Roofing: GAF (403, bot-blocked), CertainTeed and IKO data sheets not retrieved; Owens Corning used throughout. ProEdge hip & ridge linear-ft per bundle not found on page.
Roofing: roof pitch multiplier (rafter length factor) table from a primary source: NOT FOUND -> compute sqrt(1+(rise/12)^2).

Gravel: sand unit weight (tons/cu yd) from a DOT/federal source: NOT FOUND. Loose (uncompacted, as-delivered) crushed stone/gravel weight per cu yd: NOT FOUND (WisDOT values are in-place compacted pay-conversion factors).
Mulch: standard bagged mulch volume (2 cu ft) from an extension source: NOT FOUND.
Concrete: IRC R506.1 (3.5 in min slab) primary text: NOT FOUND - codes.iccsafe.org is a JavaScript app (curl returns an empty shell; WebFetch 403); no .gov full-text copy located without search.

Decks: IRC 2021 R507 text not reachable (same ICC issue); DCA 6 retrieved is the 2015-IRC edition (c)2018, whose spans may differ from IRC 2021 Table R507.6 - verify before publishing. DCA 6 does not contain a decking span table (SFPA used instead).

Fences: 'post hole depth = one-third of post length' and '8 ft on center for wood privacy' rules from a manufacturer/extension: NOT FOUND (only 6'x8' panel size from YellaWood and Barrette's frost-line rule). Concrete volume per post: NOT FOUND.
notes: eCFR: the human page https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-10/chapter-II/subchapter-D/part-430/subpart-C/section-430.32 also returned 200; the versioner API (requires Accept-Encoding: gzip) was used to read the text. The renderer API URL given in the brief returned 404.
Furnace 95% AFUE rule: compliance date in the eCFR text (up to date as of 2026-10-07) is December 18, 2028; until then 80% AFUE applies to non-weatherized gas furnaces.
Water heater UEF table applies to units manufactured before May 6, 2029 (new standards follow on that date).
fueleconomy.gov side-by-side page rounds kWh/100 mi to integers; unrounded combE values from the web-services API: Model Y LR AWD 27.4959, Equinox EV FWD 31.0762, Mach-E RWD 31.4375.

EPA Volume-to-Weight Conversion Factors memo (2016) lists 'Small Rock/Gravel 999 lb/cu yd' and 'Dirt and Sand 929 lb/cu yd', but these are loose C&D waste densities - deliberately NOT used for purchased aggregate.

WisDOT conversion factors (1.85 / 1.75 tons per cu yd) are for 'acceptably completed in-place' material per Standard Spec 109.1, 2025 Standard Specifications (effective with the November 2024 letting).
Owens Corning spec PDF (dms/10021602) is the 3-part guide specification 'Revised January 2026'.
Valspar product pages show a Lowe's same-day-delivery link but are served by valspar.com (manufacturer).
